The '''Shelsha sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] over fifty lightyears wide. [[Shelkonwa]] was capital world of Shelsha sector.

The [[Mungra]] were one of only two native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Allegiance" /><ref name="TCSWE" />

During the [[Rebellion era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sector governor was [[Barshnis Choard]] and the chief administrator was [[Vilim Disra]]. At this time, the only Imperial military units active in the sector were [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] garrisons on [[Minkring]] and [[Chaastern 4]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']], and several patrols of [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]].<ref name="Allegiance" />

The sector had considerable problems with pirates, especially the [[BloodScar]] gang. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was briefly held captive by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] (after Vilim Disra turned her in) there in [[0 BBY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]. During the same time, the sector was the site of the [[Teardrop massacre]].<ref name="Allegiance" />
